svg.metadata: Nieuw OS Materiaal flow icons. Original paths created for this task; no external assets, fonts, scripts, or dependencies used. Symbols: document, history, saved, retry. Each uses viewBox 0 0 24 24, currentColor, and a 1.75 px rounded stroke. Use document for object identity, history for version history, saved only after confirmed COMMIT, and retry only for a known retryable error; never retry Unknown or Uncertain. UI text and state remain the accessible status cue. A host control sheet was rendered with system librsvg and Cairo and visually inspected at 24 and 48 px on light and dark backgrounds. Native renderer consumption and QEMU rendering are not implemented or verified. No independent legal license determination is asserted.
